paragraphs.text:
EXPENSIVE HOTEL
This is the best class of hotel. It has 24-hour room service. On 
your second night here, roll 1D10: with a result of 9 or 10 go 
to entry 26. On the third night here, roll 1D10: with a result 
of 8, 9, or 10 go to entry 26. For each additional night you stay 
here, increase the chance for proceeding to entry 26 by one 
additional result; otherwise, go to any Athens Location the 
following morning; or, if Cairo, go to the Egypt Location Table.
(Athens Location or Egypt Location)
